guitar.evidence: Adam Jones' silverburst Gibson Les Paul Custom is one of the most recognizable guitars in modern progressive metal.

tone.target: dark detuned industrial fuzz with mid-scooped crunch
tone.profile: dark detuned industrial fuzz with mid-scooped crunch
tone.summary: A dark, fuzzy signal chain utilizing a Muff-style fuzz for industrial texture, followed by an aggressive UK 800 amp model and a 4x12 cab, with Chorus reserved for clean passages.
corrections: shift from generic distortion to fuzzy, industrial texture
keep chorus only as a clean-passage color
add tighter attack than loose fuzz

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum inherent in fuzzy tones.
Provides the core fuzzy, industrial texture and thick low end required for Tool's sound.
Adds controlled mid-range punch and helps tighten the attack of the fuzz without losing thickness.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for subtle tightening, as a dedicated EQ might be too surgical.

blocks.purpose: Simulates the aggressive, high-headroom British gain structure needed for modern rock/metal tones.
blocks.gap: The UK 800 is a good proxy for Mesa/Marshall voicing; specific model matching is impossible.

blocks.purpose: Provides the necessary punch and definition in the mid-range while maintaining a classic rock foundation.
Sculpts the tone by scooping out excessive high frequencies (avoiding brittle top) and boosting dark upper mids for definition.
blocks.gap: Requires careful EQ shaping to achieve the 'dark' sound without losing low-end weight.

blocks.purpose: Provides the subtle 'clean-part chorus hint' required for contrast during quieter sections.
Adds subtle depth and space without sounding like 'big reverb', maintaining the dark atmosphere.
blocks.gap: Using a minimal delay instead of reverb to avoid excessive wash/brightness.

blocks.purpose: Provides a controlled sense of space (ambience) without the washiness of big reverb.
blocks.gap: The 'big reverb' avoidance suggests minimal use, making Room/Plate suitable for subtle depth.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better mid-range punch and dark industrial tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance mid-range punch and dark, industrial character.
